herb_cottage.blurb: A low cottage at the edge of the square, its rafters hung with drying herbs. There is a cot for the sick, shelves of jars and salves, and a wall of old miners' keepsakes: lamp hooks, carved tallies, a bent pick with marks no one reads any more.
herb_cottage.name: Maude's cottage

inn_yard.blurb: Behind the Valley Inn: a muddy yard with a stable for drovers' mules, a woodpile under a lean-to, a well with a dented bucket, and two wagons with their loads tarped down. The inn's back door opens here, and a lane runs round to the square.
inn_yard.name: Inn yard

market_square.blurb: Mud and ore-carts. A Miners Guild board lists wages in tin and coin.
market_square.name: Market Square

mine_workings.blurb: A tin shaft the Guild wants to drive deeper. The air tastes of wet stone.
mine_workings.name: Mine workings

old_adit.blurb: An abandoned mine entrance in the pines, propped with rotten timbers. Old miners cut warnings into the rock above the mouth: tally marks, a lamp, and a shape like an open hand. Cart tracks, some not so old, lead inside.
old_adit.name: Old adit

orc_approach.blurb: A goat path drops toward smoke and hide tents. The trees are too quiet.
orc_approach.name: Cut above the nest

orc_nest.blurb: Smoke, hide tents, and a stolen cache. The chieftain's warband holds this cut.
orc_nest.name: Orc nest

smithy.blurb: An open-fronted forge off the square, hot even at night. Picks wait for new points, a rack holds knives, spearheads and a few honest swords, and a back door opens onto the lane. Half-sorted tin ingots sit in a crate by the coal.
smithy.name: Brask's forge

valley_inn.blurb: A timber inn at the foot of the tin road. Miners drink here. The valley road runs east toward the cut.
valley_inn.name: Valley Inn

west_road.blurb: The drovers' road leaves the square and runs down-valley under the pines. Deep cart ruts, a broken axle in the ditch, and a weathered shrine stone where drovers leave a copper for luck. A side track climbs into the trees toward the old workings.
west_road.name: West road

crossroads_square.blurb: Mud and cobbles churned by cart wheels. Merchants hawk wares beneath a weathered signpost.
crossroads_square.name: Crossroads Square

pilgrim_cellar.blurb: Cool stone steps descend to casks and shadows. The air tastes of wine and damp mortar.
pilgrim_cellar.name: Pilgrim Cellar

weary_pilgrim.blurb: A low-ceilinged tavern smelling of woodsmoke and spilled ale. Chalk marks score the slate behind the bar.
weary_pilgrim.name: The Weary Pilgrim
